rules.statement: A party seeking to amend the pleadings after the first date of trial must establish the existence of both ingredients in section 93(2) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: The application to amend the plaint was clearly a belated application made after three trial dates - section 93 (2) would become operative and applicable.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 93 (2) of the Civil Procedure Code
